note: Words added to the website dictionary because people search for them (DECISIONS.md 2026-11-18, point 1). A word comes in only when at least two sources attest its spelling and its sense; the meaning is written in our own words and covers only the sense two sources share. The sources field is a citation (source and place), never a source's wording. One row per source for each word is in audits/dictionary-search-2026-11-18/additions-evidence.tsv in the project folder. These words are never in book-vocabulary.json.
